visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor night scene at a busy urban center. A young woman in a black jacket and shorts stands near a mall entrance with ATT 4 FUN branding. Neon blue and purple lights reflect off the floor and walls. She is surrounded by a crowd of moving pedestrians. Her expression is expectant while her hands are slightly fidgety. (2) Close-up on two women interacting. One in a white lace-trimmed skirt and light-colored top holds hands with another woman who has light blonde hair and a black top. They smile warmly at each other, displaying excited facial expressions and small hand gestures. The background is a brightly lit storefront with soft indoor lighting. (3) The group moves to a service counter area labeled wens. A friend in a denim jacket introduces the two women to each other. They all laugh and gesture enthusiastically. The lighting is bright and studio-like, highlighting bottles and menus on the counter. The main character looks ecstatic with her mouth open in a laugh. (4) A montage of poses follows. The three women stand together in front of the counter, making finger-heart signs and peace signs with their hands. They look directly at the camera, smiling broadly. A final sequence shows a blurry still photo followed by a black screen with white text overlays.
